body:
AMEND — two blocking component-closure defects; the legal-media versus typed-envelope split and the overall claim ceiling are otherwise sound.

1. The source correction over-constrains the pixel path. Its narrow statement about the generic MOV `raw ` tag is true: the pinned raw decoder maps 24-bit MOV fallback to RGB24. But the conclusion that MOV therefore requires RGB-to-BGR conversion or a different container omits a second pinned path. FFmpeg 9.0.1 commit bf1b838 has BGR24 mapped to MOV fourcc `24BG` in movenc, and the raw decoder tag table maps `24BG` back to BGR24:
- https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/blob/bf1b838f2ab88b4f8fd83443325c782ea0e0f7fa/libavcodec/raw.c#L38-L64
- https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/blob/bf1b838f2ab88b4f8fd83443325c782ea0e0f7fa/libavformat/movenc.c#L2063-L2070
- https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/blob/bf1b838f2ab88b4f8fd83443325c782ea0e0f7fa/libavcodec/raw_pix_fmt_tags.h#L253-L258

Required revision: retain two candidates until a pinned end-to-end conformance receipt selects one: MOV `raw ` plus RGB24 plus an admitted RGB-to-BGR bridge, or MOV `24BG` plus direct BGR24 decode. FFmpeg table membership is feasibility evidence, not standards-validity or realization evidence. In either route, exact fourcc, pixel format, dimensions, stride, row orientation, ownership/lifetime, color metadata, per-sample input/output hashes, and sample identity must be bound. If `24BG` is selected there is no color-channel bridge, but a BGR handoff normalizer still needs its own record and refusal policy.

2. V1 names responsibilities but does not yet close them as independently admitted leaves. The successor must enumerate at least these leaves and keep their ceilings separate:
- F0 generator: exact project source, runtime, dependencies, licence/notices, environment contract, and digest. If it calls any FFmpeg muxer/encoder, that is a distinct generator FFmpeg realization, not `decode.ffmpeg`; the landed recipe disables the ffmpeg program, muxers, encoders, and every decoder. Enabling the MOV muxer also selects additional pinned configure closure: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/blob/bf1b838f2ab88b4f8fd83443325c782ea0e0f7fa/configure#L3965-L3968 . Generator two-run equality proves determinism only, not container validity.
- Independent container-layout validator: a different implementation/code path from the generator. An intent-derived box-layout receipt is provenance, not validation, and differential success in the MOV demuxer under test is not an independent legality oracle. This leaf may validate only the declared MOV subset; until it is realized, the phrase standards-valid remains held.
- Independent semantic oracle: separate implementation and cache identity from the generator and layout validator. It may establish intent-derived schedules, exact expected mappings, sample payload hashes, silence/tone/text expectations, and physical-transition intervals. It cannot establish container validity, decoder correctness, or detector quality merely because expected and generated values share an intent.
- Reader codec closure: `mov` demuxing alone cannot prove decoded RGB/BGR pixels, PCM samples, or text. Select and admit `rawvideo_decoder`, one exact PCM decoder and tag/sample format, and the exact timed-text reader. PCM must name endian/width, fourcc such as `sowt` or `twos`, sample rate, channel count/layout, and packet/sample framing. Timed text must choose embedded MOV text such as `tx3g` plus `movtext_decoder`, or an exact sidecar format plus its parser/demuxer/decoder; a generic timed-text sidecar is not a closed leaf. Synthetic text still needs the text-admission record.
- RGB-to-BGR bridge or direct-BGR handoff: separate from FFmpeg and PySceneDetect, with analytic channel-order controls, padded and non-padded stride cases, row orientation, ownership, hashes, and fail-closed unsupported layouts. Its ceiling is byte-layout preservation/channel permutation, not color-science equivalence or boundary validity.

3. Gap feasibility needs one exact choice. The pinned MOV muxer writes one content edit plus an optional leading empty edit when presentation is delayed; it does not provide an arbitrary interior empty-edit schedule: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/blob/bf1b838f2ab88b4f8fd83443325c782ea0e0f7fa/libavformat/movenc.c#L4172-L4198 . A legal first fixture can therefore place a leading picture-track empty edit while audio continues from edition zero. An interior picture-free interval needs a custom layout writer plus the independent validator, or a separate fixture. A native timestamp/sample gap must not be relabelled as an edit-list gap; those are distinct phenomena and should be separate fixtures if both are claimed.

4. Keep legal media and typed mutation envelopes as separate artifact classes, with distinct schema IDs, manifests, hashes, receipts, caches, and claim language. The legal bundle can prove behavior on one valid source. The envelope corpus can prove portable classification/refusal laws but cannot prove demuxer behavior, parser robustness, or that an invalid packet pair can exist as valid MOV bytes. No third class is needed for V1 under the stated ceiling. If malformed-container/security behavior is later claimed, add a separately admitted malformed-byte corpus rather than promoting envelopes to media.

With those amendments, the ceiling is honest: generator determinism, declared-subset layout conformance, intent-oracle agreement, exact ingest/coverage/mapping/refusal preservation, and detector measurement/proposal plumbing only. No implementation, runtime, component, media, or authorization follows from this review.
